# Describe the Account Hub select by its actual control role

AccountHubSelect is an HTMLElement that constructs an internal native select, label and warning/help descriptions, but its current leading comment calls it the main action button for in-app notifications. Recommend correcting that copied description when touching the component. This is a scoped semantic documentation proposal; the tagname and class alone do not repair a wrong role description. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
